installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## App 1007 is the Steamworks redist; the server is a Windows-only build, so both are pulled with the platform forced.
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update 1007 +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## The server only registers with Steam when these sit next to the binary.
for lib in steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do
    if [[ -f /mnt/server/${lib} ]]; then
        cp -v /mnt/server/${lib} /mnt/server/DNL/Binaries/Win64/${lib}
    fi
done

## touch log file so the console has something to tail on a fresh install
mkdir -p /mnt/server/DNL/Saved/Logs
echo "--fresh install--" >> /mnt/server/DNL/Saved/Logs/DNL.log

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Map
variables.description: The map to load. DNL_ALL is the default map (Cape of Sacred Path), TheShard is the DLC map.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name the server is listed under in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: If specified, players must provide this password to join the server.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for in-game admin commands and RCON. RCON is how the panel stops the server cleanly, so this cannot be blank.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server at once.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, used by the Steam and in-game server browsers. Needs its own allocation.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port. Bound to 127.0.0.1 by the panel's stop command, so it does not have to be reachable from outside.

variables.name: Additional Arguments (PARAMS)
variables.description: Extra ? options, which must be typed touching each other with no spaces: ?DifficultyOffset=1.0?ServerPVE=True

variables.name: Additional Arguments (FLAGS)
variables.description: Extra - flags, separated by spaces: -useallavailablecores -usecache. Add -nosteamclient here if the server crashes on boot; it will then not appear in the Steam server browser.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app ID of the DNL Dedicated Server. Do not change.

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Forces SteamCMD to fetch the Windows build. The server has no Linux build, so this cannot be changed.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server through SteamCMD on every boot.

variables.name: Beta ID
variables.description: Beta branch of the steam app. Leave blank to install the normal branch.

variables.name: Beta Password
variables.description: Password for a beta branch, should one require it. Leave blank for no password.
